prompt: Create a vertical stylized anime character portrait of a young female cafe barista shown from mid-thigh up against a clean warm off-white studio background. She has messy black hair with a side-swept fringe, loose strands framing her face, and a low tousled bun at the back; sharp expressive brown eyes behind thin round glasses; delicate angular facial features; a calm, slightly serious expression; and a recognizable slim silhouette. Dress her in a crisp white button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, a black neck scarf tied loosely like a ribbon, and a rust brown cafe apron with dark brown shoulder straps and a tied waist sash. Her posture is relaxed and professional, one arm bent across her body while holding a takeaway coffee cup with a black lid near her waist. Use a distinctive character-driven anime aesthetic with slightly unconventional facial proportions, clean confident linework, sketchy ink accents, warm muted colors, soft cel shading, subtle fabric folds, and minimal background detail. Add a faint blurred foreground hint of cafe equipment at the lower left for depth, but keep the focus entirely on the character. No text, no logo, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张竖版风格化动漫角色肖像，主角为 一位年轻女性咖啡师，画面呈现大腿中部以上，背景为简洁温暖的米白色摄影棚背景。她留着 凌乱的黑色 头发，侧分刘海，几缕发丝垂在脸颊旁，脑后扎着一个低低的凌乱发髻；透过细圆框眼镜可以看到锐利且富有表现力的棕色眼睛；面部轮廓精致分明；表情冷静且略带严肃；拥有极具辨识度的纤细剪裁。身穿一件清爽的白色衬衫，袖口卷起，颈部系着一条松散的黑色丝带围巾，外搭一件 铁锈棕色 的咖啡师围裙，配有深棕色肩带和系腰带。姿态放松且专业，一只手臂横在身前，腰部附近握着 一个带黑色盖子的外带咖啡杯。采用独特的角色驱动型动漫美学，面部比例略显非传统，线条干净利落且自信，带有写意水墨风格，色调温暖柔和，采用轻微的赛璐珞阴影，布料褶皱细腻，背景细节极简。左下角添加一点模糊的咖啡设备前景以增加深度，但视觉焦点应完全集中在角色身上。无文字，无 Logo，无水印。
